popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Homer's Phaeacian founder: son of Poseidon and Periboea who leads his people from Hypereia to Scheria, walls the city, and fathers Rhexenor and Alcinous — the king whose court will host Odysseus.

popCulture.title: Nausithous
popCulture.description: Godlike settler of Scheria — carefully distinct from Hesiod's Nausithous, son of Odysseus and Calypso.

popCulture.title: Alcinous
popCulture.description: Nausithous' son — the Phaeacian king of perfect hospitality whose palace, gifts, and self-steering ships close Odysseus' wanderings.

popCulture.title: Scheria
popCulture.description: The Phaeacian island Nausithous founds far from the Cyclopes — the last harbor before Ithaca in Homeric geography.
